purpose: Minimal Q42-semantic sample used by R0 reproduction to show the original gate accepts evidence bound only to the mutable working tree (no immutable Git-object pin).

counterfactual.definition: A bounded 'what-if X had happened instead' statement about an IDENTIFIABLE portion of the observed system.
counterfactual.claim: bounded; only the identifiable portion receives counterfactual status

alternative_decomposition.definition: A different way to break down the SAME observed system. It is a reframing, not a claim about what would have happened.

unrealized_path.definition: A decision or trajectory that was NOT taken. It remains speculative: it was never realized and cannot be observed.

speculative_narrative.definition: An if-then story used for reasoning. It is explicitly labeled speculation and is NOT a causal fact.

intervention_difference.note: Counterfactuals here assume NO external intervention was performed; if an external action had occurred it would be a different capability boundary.

identifiability.observable_portion: the parts of the system whose state is recorded and reproducible
identifiability.unobservable_portion: the parts that were never measured; they remain unobservable and are NOT promoted to fact

non_claims: if-then story is not causal fact
alternative decomposition is not counterfactual proof
